comment: Single source of truth for affiliate links. Content pages link to /go/<id>; the Cloudflare Pages Function at functions/go/[id].js logs the click and redirects to `url`. Add a link here, run `npm run affiliate`, and the build rewrites matching .rec-btn hrefs across site/*.html. Keep `url` exactly as the network issued it (tracking params matter).
